jobs.occupation: Power System Studies Engineer
jobs.description:
The opportunity
With a pioneering technology-leading offering, Hitachi Power Quality Solutions supports the green energy transition with solutions that bring resilience, stability and increased capacity to the power grid. As a result, more renewable energy sources can be integrated, minimized environmental impacts and lower the risk of disruption in the grid.
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Product Engineer – Power System Studies. This role is key to managing the lifecycle, requirements, configuration, and roadmap of our tools and solutions within the Power System Studies discipline. Embedded in the Engineering function, you’ll collaborate closely with technical teams to ensure our solutions meet both business needs and industry standards.
How you’ll make an impact
Undertaking various simulation studies, such as dynamic performance studies, individually or as part of a team on a daily basis to analyze FACTS plants and verify their performance in the connected grid
Making reports out of studies and presenting to customers
Understanding customer needs by reading customer specifications and participating in customer meetings
Coordination and communication with all disciplines involved in project and tender deliveries as well as in close connection to research and development activities
Having ambition in learning and sharing critical knowledge in today’s power system
As Sweden is the Global Center of Competence for FACTS engineering within Hitachi, you will be in frequent contact with the other engineering disciplines, sub-suppliers, project managers, customers and other Hitachi units in an international environment.
Collaborate, train colleagues, and offer technical support throughout the complete delivery.

Your background
You hold an M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or similar and have at least five years of job experience within power systems analysis
It is preferred that you have knowledge and experience of the programs and tools we are using: RTDS, PSCAD, PSS/E, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, MATLAB, EMTP-RV, Python etc
It is considered as a merit if you have previous experience in modelling of windfarms and studying their stability in projects with the STATCOM application along with Synchronous Condenser Machine modeling and studies
It is considered as a merit if you have previous experience of working in tenders and are familiar with activities such as cost estimation, coordination with sales, understanding customer specification
Since you will be working in an international environment it is essential that you communicate fluently in English. Additional language skills are qualifying but not required.
It is essential that you are a curious person and have good communication skills, and like to work individually and as a team in a dynamic and multicultural environment

More about us
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
Health care and wellness allowance ​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
Psychological support program ​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today. ​

jobs.occupation: Sourcing Manager IT
jobs.description:
Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come. 
Your opportunity 
Ready to shape how we source IT at Boliden? Join us as a Sourcing Manager and bring together technology, business and strategic sourcing. Your work will help us make smart commercial decisions while developing how we source IT across Boliden.  
We are looking for two Sourcing Managers to strengthen our IT procurement team. You will work with sourcing across software, digital services and technology supporting our industrial operations. Along the way, you will build strong supplier relationships, manage commercial risks and help create long-term value for Boliden. 
We welcome candidates at different stages of their careers. Your level of responsibility will reflect your experience, giving you the opportunity to grow while learning from colleagues with different areas of expertise. 
Who you will work with 
You will be part of Group Procurement and work closely with colleagues within IT, procurement and different parts of Boliden's business. You will also build relationships with IT suppliers, consultants and service providers.
Collaboration and knowledge sharing are important parts of the role. You will work with colleagues who bring different areas of expertise, while having the opportunity to take ownership of your sourcing assignments and contribute your own ideas. 
The positions can be based in Stockholm or Boliden, with another Boliden location potentially considered by agreement. We work according to an Office First approach, with the office as the main workplace. Business travel is part of the role and varies according to business and project needs. 
What you will do 
Key responsibilities are: 
Lead strategic sourcing IT initiatives from understanding the business need through supplier selection, contracting and implementation. 
Manage and negotiate IT contracts and commercial terms across areas such as software, licensing, hardware, IT services, consulting and telecom. 
Translate technical and business needs into clear commercial requirements and sourcing decisions. 
Build trusted relationships with IT, procurement, business stakeholders and external suppliers. 
Analyze spend and supplier markets to identify sourcing opportunities and support informed decisions. 
Contribute to IT category strategies and the continued development of how Boliden procures IT products and services. 
Contribute to responsible sourcing by balancing commercial value, sustainability, compliance and risk. 

What you bring 
You enjoy creating structure when several priorities need attention and are comfortable taking responsibility for moving an assignment forward while involving others when their expertise is needed. 
You build trusted relationships by listening to different perspectives and communicating clearly. You are comfortable working between technical and commercial stakeholders and can turn complex information into practical sourcing decisions. 
You approach challenges with curiosity and a solution-oriented mindset. You are also comfortable constructively questioning existing approaches and contributing ideas for improvement. We value colleagues who share knowledge, ask questions and contribute to an open and collaborative working environment. 
Qualifications are: 
An academic degree or relevant professional experience that provides an equivalent foundation. 
Experience in strategic sourcing or procurement. 
Understanding of IT contracts, commercial agreements and licensing models. 
Ability to understand technical concepts and translate them into commercial requirements and decisions. 
Professional proficiency in English. 
Category B driving licence. 

It is an advantage if you have: 
Experience in IT procurement or sourcing is an advantage, particularly within areas such as software, IT services, consulting, hardware or telecom. You may also bring knowledge of data protection, GDPR or cybersecurity, or experience from an IT organization, supplier or international company. Swedish or Finnish is a plus. 
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification listed. We value potential, motivation, and a willingness to learn and grow together with us.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager (Identity & Access Management)
jobs.description:
TL;DR: We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape Lovable’s Identity & Access Management team and own how authentication, authorization, and identity work across the existing Lovable app ecosystem and the more than one million new apps built every week. You’ll work with a talented team of engineers and designers to build open, scalable identity primitives that serve individual builders, enterprises, application users, developers, and AI agents without compromising Lovable’s simplicity.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we’re looking for
Significant experience owning technically complex products, across identity, authentication, authorization, developer platforms, or infrastructure.
A track record of setting product direction in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning teams around a clear strategy, and turning that strategy into shipped products.
Strong knowledge of modern identity systems and open standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, passkeys, service accounts, roles, permissions, and policy-based access control.
Technical fluency. You program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on platform architecture, APIs, data models, security boundaries, and identity protocols.
Strong product sense and systems thinking. You can prioritize across authentication, authorization, and identity needs while building simple primitives that can support enormous scale and increasingly sophisticated use cases.
Exceptional communication skills and sharp judgment. You can navigate difficult tradeoffs, explain the options and consequences clearly, and help teams reach informed decisions.
A deep appreciation for the needs of personal and enterprise users, as well as both sides of the Lovable experience: the builder configuring identity and the end user interacting with a Lovable-built app.

What you’ll do
Represent the user. Develop a deep understanding of identity needs across existing Lovable-built apps and the more than one million new apps created every week.
Own the product strategy and roadmap for authentication, authorization, and identity, making deliberate tradeoffs between immediate user needs and durable platform foundations.
Define standards-based primitives for users, organizations, agents, roles, permissions, policies, sessions, and delegated access that can scale across a vast and varied application ecosystem.
Shape a smooth identity experience for both builders configuring their apps and the people using those apps.
Partner closely with engineering to balance the needs of individual builders and enterprise organizations, preserving Lovable’s simplicity while building a foundation that can scale.
Define how AI agents and other non-human identities authenticate, receive authority, act on behalf of users, and remain understandable and controllable.
Own identity and access needs for programmatic use of Lovable across API, CLI, SDK, and MCP surfaces.
Keep it simple. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn’t.

Projects you’ll tackle first: Partner with engineering to shape and deliver a multi-tenant identity service built on open standards that supports authentication and authorization across millions of applications and provides a durable foundation for Lovable.
About your application
Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

Lead client workshops to understand current processes, identify needs and define requirements. 
Translate indirect tax and e-invoicing regulations into clear process and system requirements. 
Design practical solutions and documentation that connect tax, finance and technology.

Meritorious

Curious and motivated to learn in a fast-changing specialist area.

Goal oriented

Stable
Responsible

Receive, review, and register customer orders, primarily via email.
Ensure that order documentation, pricing, and delivery terms are accurate and complete.
Communicate with customers and sales representatives to clarify or obtain missing order information.
Coordinate complex orders involving multiple factories, deliveries, and internal functions.
Monitor order progress and ensure that products are delivered according to schedule.
Collaborate with service coordinators and project managers to prepare for product installations.
Ensure a smooth and accurate handover to the service organization.
Follow up on open orders and ensure that invoicing takes place at the correct time.
Manage partial deliveries and invoicing in multiple stages.
Communicate deviations and changes in invoicing schedules to the finance department.
Take ownership of your orders and ensure that each process is followed through to completion.

About You:
We are looking for someone with previous experience in order coordination, order management, sales support, or qualified B2B customer service.
You have a good understanding of how different parts of an order process are connected, from receiving an order to coordinating deliveries and ensuring that invoicing is completed correctly.
You are comfortable taking ownership of your work, coordinating multiple stakeholders, and handling both routine tasks and more complex situations. You understand the importance of keeping track of details while maintaining an overview of the entire process.
To Succeed in This Role, We Believe You Have:
Approximately two years of experience in a similar position.
Previous experience in order coordination, order management, sales support, or qualified B2B customer service.
Experience independently managing and following up on order processes, preferably from order placement through to delivery and invoicing.
An understanding of how orders, deliveries, installations, and invoicing are connected.
Experience coordinating several internal and external stakeholders.
The ability to manage complex cases and keep multiple processes moving simultaneously.
Previous experience working with ERP or other business management systems.
Good general computer skills and the ability to quickly learn new systems and processes.
Excellent communication skills in Finnish and English, both written and spoken.

Experience working with SAP or Salesforce is also considered a plus.
Who Are You as a Person?
You are a responsible, structured, and proactive individual who enjoys taking ownership and driving processes forward.
You are detail-oriented and understand the importance of accuracy when handling customer orders, deliveries, and invoicing. At the same time, you are able to maintain an overview and ensure that all the different parts of the process come together.
You are confident in making decisions and taking action when something needs to be resolved. Rather than waiting for someone else to follow up, you take initiative and make sure things get done.
You also have strong communication skills and enjoy working with different stakeholders, both internally and externally. You understand the importance of keeping everyone informed and ensuring smooth collaboration between departments.
Interested?

jobs.occupation: Head of Production
jobs.description:
Did you know that Sweden's largest shipyard for ship repair and conversion projects is in Landskrona? At Oresund DryDocks, vessels from across Northern Europe and beyond come to us for complex repair, maintenance and conversion projects. With a strong reputation for quality, safety and delivery performance, we are a leading player in the maritime industry.
Our success is built on the expertise and commitment of approximately 110 employees, working across project management, engineering, production and support functions. 
We are now looking for a Head of Production to lead and further develop our production organization.
The Role as Head of Production
As Head of Production, you will have overall responsibility for leading, developing and optimizing the production organization through your department managers within Steel, Piping, Mechanical, and Dock & Transport.
You will ensure that the organization has the right resources, competencies, processes and working methods in place to successfully deliver projects according to established targets for safety, quality, cost efficiency and delivery performance.
As a member of the management team, you will play a key role in driving operational excellence and contributing to the company's long-term strategic development. The position requires a visible and engaged leadership style, with a strong presence in the business and close collaboration with employees, customers and stakeholders.
Experience
You have several years of experience in a senior production leadership role within the maritime, shipyard, manufacturing or other project-driven industrial sectors.
You have a proven track record of:

Leading managers and larger production organizations through delegated responsibility

Driving operational performance and achieving demanding business objectives

Developing organizations, processes and working methods to improve efficiency, productivity and delivery precision

Building and strengthening a proactive safety culture with a strong focus on HSEQ

Managing operations in an international business environment

Experience from project-driven production environments where flexibility, coordination and customer focus are critical is highly valued.
Leadership Profile
You are a confident and inspiring leader who leads by example. Through clear communication and a structured approach, you create engagement, accountability and commitment throughout the organization.
You are results-oriented and combine a strong business mindset with a genuine interest in people development. You can balance strategic thinking with operational execution and are comfortable making decisions in a dynamic environment.
To succeed in the role, you should have:

Strong leadership and people management skills

Excellent planning and organizational abilities

A strong focus on quality, safety and customer satisfaction

Good technical understanding and the ability to translate business objectives into operational activities

Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, written and spoken

Meritorious Qualifications

Experience from the shipbuilding, ship repair or maritime industry

Experience in Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement

What We Offer
At Oresund DryDocks, you will become part of a highly skilled and dedicated team operating within an exciting international industry.
We offer a challenging and varied leadership role with significant opportunities to influence both operational performance and the future development of the company. Our organization is characterized by short decision-making paths, a collaborative culture and a strong commitment to continuous improvement.
You will work alongside talented colleagues from diverse backgrounds who share a passion for delivering high-quality solutions to our customers. We believe that every employee contributes to our success and we actively support both personal and professional development.

jobs.occupation: CEO for a pioneering technology company
jobs.description:
Do you thrive on creating business value, leading people and bringing pioneering technology to market? Would you like to spearhead a company developing innovative solutions for growing international markets?
Our client is looking for a CEO to lead its next phase, working closely with the engineers and scientists behind the company's technology. You will develop the business, bring the organisation together around clear priorities and build the international relationships that turn technical progress into commercial opportunities.
This is an opportunity to lead the commercialization of proprietary technology, combining the expertise of a highly qualified technical team with your own ability to build an international business.
Does this sound like the opportunity for you? Read on.

About the role
As CEO, you will lead and develop the company across its two business areas. You will shape the business strategy with the board and take responsibility for its execution within the agreed budget, translating it into priorities and shared goals.
You will act on and create business opportunities and personally drive key commercial relationships and negotiations. Working closely with the technical leadership, CFO/COO and board, you will unite customer needs, technical capabilities and financial priorities.
The role calls for commercial judgement and enough technical understanding to work confidently with customers, partners and specialists. You will draw on the expertise within the organisation while taking responsibility for decisions, direction and progress.
The company is based in Gothenburg, Sweden. The role requires regular on-site presence with the team and international travel.

In this role you will

Develop and execute the commercial direction in alignment with the board, focusing on markets and opportunities with the strongest commercial potential.

Use and develop your international network to build relationships with industrial customers and partners.

Personally drive complex business opportunities from initial dialogue through negotiation to agreement.

Build internal structures, with clear responsibilities, decision-making and follow-up.

Lead the organisation towards shared goals, aligning technical development and resources with business priorities.

Prioritize resources towards the most attractive opportunities within the agreed budget, taking responsibility for cash flow and funding planning together with the CFO/COO and board.

Communicate progress, opportunities and risks clearly to employees, the board and investors.

Build relationships with investors and lead capital raising initiatives.

To succeed in this role you will bring

Experience leading and developing a technology-intensive business, business unit or commercial function, with responsibility for people, resources and financial results.

The ability to turn strategic goals into clear priorities, effective ways of working and measurable progress.

A hands-on approach with the ability to deliver results in a small organization with limited resources.

A proven record of personally developing and closing complex international B2B technology agreements with industrial customers.

A relevant international industry network and experience bringing new technology to market, including customer testing, qualification or development partnerships.

Solid technical understanding and commercial experience from technology-driven markets such as advanced electronics, materials, energy technology, industrial technology or related fields.

A relevant educational background in technology or business, or equivalent professional experience, excellent English and the ability to travel internationally.

Additional experience we value
Previous CEO responsibility, capital raising and experience in a listed company is valuable. Experience in industrial automation, telecommunications, sensor technology or advanced manufacturing may also be relevant where it includes comparable commercialisation and industrial business development.

You are a clear and approachable leader who takes responsibility for the whole business. You listen to the expertise around you, make considered decisions and explain the priorities behind them. You enjoy creating opportunities and stay involved in the work needed to move them forward. jobs.occupation: Join our Backend Team in Gothenburg
jobs.description:
TECHLA is a Gothenburg-based consulting company working with modern product development across software, embedded systems, cloud and DevOps.
We started TECHLA with a simple idea: to build the kind of consulting company we would want to work for ourselves. We want to build long-term relationships, work with great people and create an environment where both our consultants and our clients can thrive.
We believe in transparency, trust and giving people the freedom and responsibility to grow. Our consultants should feel that they are part of something, have a real influence and are rewarded for the value they create.
At TECHLA, technology matters – but people matter even more. We believe the best results come from skilled people who take ownership, work closely together and genuinely care about what they deliver.
We are big enough to deliver, but small enough to care.
We’re looking for experienced Backend Developers in Gothenburg who combine strong technical skills with ownership, curiosity and a genuine drive to move things forward.
What you’ll be working with
You’ll join a development team at one of our clients, building and operating modern backend services and cloud-based platforms for connected products and digital services.
The exact technology stack will vary by assignment. It may include Java, C#/.NET, Python or Go, together with AWS and/or Azure. Some teams focus on customer-facing backend services, while others develop cloud platforms, integrations and developer tools.
You’ll work in a collaborative, DevOps-oriented environment and contribute throughout the service lifecycle, from design and development to deployment, monitoring, operations and continuous improvement.
Your work may include
Developing and maintaining backend services using Java, C#/.NET, Python and/or Go
Designing and building cloud-native solutions on AWS or Azure
Building REST APIs, microservices and integrations
Working with event-driven systems and distributed architectures
Using cloud services such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB and SQS
Working with containers and Kubernetes, depending on the team
Improving CI/CD, automation, monitoring, logging and service reliability
Contributing to code reviews, technical discussions and architecture decisions

Skills & qualifications
We’re looking for someone with:
At least 5 years of professional backend development experience
Strong experience in at least one of the following: Java, C#/.NET, Python or Go.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Azure
Experience building and operating APIs, services or distributed systems
A good understanding of software quality, reliability and maintainability
Fluent written and spoken English
A BSc or MSc in Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Good to have
AWS serverless experience, such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB or SQS
Experience with Azure services
Experience with Kubernetes and containerized applications
CI/CD and DevOps practices
Event-driven architecture or tools such as Kafka
Experience in connected services, IoT, automotive or telecom
Fluent written and spoken Swedish

The mindset we’re looking for
For us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills.
We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on.
You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. You take initiative, move things forward and care about delivering work you can genuinely be proud of.
At the same time, you genuinely enjoy working with others. You communicate openly, share knowledge, contribute to a positive team dynamic and believe that the best results are created together.
You take responsibility for the bigger picture, stay solution-oriented and aren’t afraid to go the extra mile when it makes a difference. At the same time, you’re humble, genuine and enjoy working with people who challenge and support each other.
In short, we’re looking for engineers who want to go beyond – technically, professionally and as part of a team.
We’re open to both employment and freelance/subcontractor setups – so whether you’re looking to join TECHLA or take on your next assignment as an independent consultant, we’d love to hear from you.
Feel free to reach out to johanna.bornemyr@techla.se or submit your application, and we’ll be happy to tell you more about the opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
The Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer will report to the Commissioning & Start-Up (CSU) Manager and lead the commissioning, start-up and performance testing of mechanical equipment and piping systems.
The role requires extensive knowledge of static and rotating equipment, piping systems, nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping testing and associated commissioning activities. Strong technical, organisational and leadership skills are essential to manage mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover in accordance with project requirements, industry standards and HSSE expectations.
Key Responsibilities
Commissioning & Start-Up
Lead commissioning and start-up activities for mechanical equipment and piping systems, coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams.
Develop and execute commissioning plans, schedules, procedures and test requirements covering mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up.
Coordinate system readiness and commissioning priorities in line with project schedules and operational requirements.
Support plant start-up, performance testing and transition to stable operations.

Mechanical & Piping Technical Leadership
Provide technical leadership for static and rotating equipment and associated piping systems.
Oversee nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping integrity testing and other pre-commissioning activities.
Ensure mechanical and piping systems comply with approved engineering specifications, relevant standards and project requirements.
Review system configuration, piping arrangements, test requirements and commissioning documentation.
Provide technical guidance to commissioning engineers, contractors and vendor representatives.

Testing & Inspection
Oversee testing and inspection of mechanical equipment and piping systems to verify integrity, functionality and readiness.
Ensure piping test packages, leak testing and mechanical inspection activities are completed and documented.
Verify completion of required inspections and tests prior to system energisation, introduction of process media or start-up.
Monitor deficiencies and ensure outstanding items are addressed before handover.

Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution
Identify and resolve mechanical and piping issues encountered during pre-commissioning and commissioning.
Work with engineering, construction, vendors and operations teams to investigate faults and implement appropriate solutions.
Identify technical constraints affecting system readiness and escalate critical issues where required.

Documentation & Handover
Maintain accurate commissioning records, including test results, checklists, punch lists and relevant as-built documentation.
Ensure commissioning documentation and completion evidence are accurate, traceable and ready for handover.
Manage punch-list close-out and support system walkdowns and acceptance activities.
Support final system handover to operations.

Performance Testing
Lead mechanical and piping aspects of plant performance testing.
Verify systems and equipment meet defined performance and operational criteria.
Support optimisation and corrective activities identified during start-up and performance testing.

HSSE & Compliance
Ensure commissioning activities comply with project HSSE requirements, industry standards and applicable regulations.
Promote safe working practices and a strong safety culture throughout mechanical and piping commissioning.
Ensure appropriate controls are applied to pressure testing, leak testing and other high-risk commissioning activities.

Stakeholder & Team Coordination
Collaborate with the CSU Manager, engineering, construction, operations, vendors, contractors and other commissioning disciplines.
Coordinate commissioning interfaces and ensure activities align with overall project objectives and schedules.
Provide leadership, technical guidance and mentoring to commissioning personnel.
Identify opportunities to improve commissioning methods, system readiness and execution efficiency.

Technical Skills
Extensive knowledge of static and rotating mechanical equipment and piping systems.
Strong expertise in nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management and piping integrity testing.
Knowledge of mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and performance testing.
Strong understanding of relevant ASME, ANSI and API standards.
Experience with piping and commissioning systems/software; SmartPlant or Hexagon experience is advantageous.
Strong planning, scheduling, resource management and project coordination capability.
API 570, ASME B31.3 or other relevant mechanical/piping certification is advantageous.
Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills.

Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum 10 years' experience commissioning mechanical equipment and piping systems within major industrial projects.
Demonstrable experience with static and rotating equipment, piping systems, mechanical completion and commissioning.
Proven expertise in leak testing, flange management, piping testing, pre-commissioning, start-up and plant performance testing.
Strong knowledge of industry standards and regulatory requirements applicable to mechanical and piping systems.
Ability to lead commissioning activities within complex, fast-paced project environments.
Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder-management skills.
Proficiency with relevant commissioning systems and software.
Green hydrogen and/or green steel experience is advantageous.
Project management experience or qualifications are advantageous.
Fluent English required; Swedish language skills are advantageous but not essential.

jobs.occupation: Account Executive for Ecoroute
jobs.description:
Are you driven, business‑oriented, and eager to grow within B2B sales? We are now looking for an Account Executive who will have the opportunity to be part of scaling a new, AI‑driven product within a European software group. You’ll take on a central role in a successful and ambitious team, with strong opportunities to develop and make a real impact. Sounds interesting? Keep on reading!
Movement Software is a Northern European software group focused on niched industry verticals. In our Transport, Logistics & Geodata vertical, Ecoroute/Tetrasoft, Geposit, Postnummerservice, and Dimaps form a strong ecosystem of specialized software companies. Through close collaboration, they deliver complementary solutions that help businesses improve efficiency, gain better control, and navigate an increasingly complex world.
In our companies, we develop data‑driven software solutions that solve real operational challenges for our customers. Our value-adding offering includes address & geodata solutions, geographical management tools, last‑meter delivery planning & production systems and route optimization & delivery execution platforms. Our customers are mainly within transportation, logistics, and field services – but we also help companies in other industries as well.
With our newly developed next-generation platform, Ecoroute, we are redefining how companies plan, optimize and execute their daily transportation operations. From route optimization to real-time execution, we help our customers reduce costs, improve service levels, and make better decisions every day.
About the role As an Account Executive you will play a key role in driving the growth across Sweden and other Nordic and Northern European countries. You will own the full sales cycle from first contact to signed deal, working closely with decision-makers in transport, logistics, and field service industries. You will collaborate with product and customer teams to ensure a strong fit and high-quality customer experience.
You will be part of an ambitious, high-performance environment where we push each other to improve and win together. The position is based in Malmö, Sweden, located at one of our sister companies to ensure close collaboration to Geopt’s Chief Commercial Officer, who is based in Denmark.
Your responsibilities:

Prospect, qualify, and build a strong pipeline of potential customers.

Lead customer meetings, both digital and in person, an demonstrate the value of our offerings – with particular focus on Ecoroute.

Drive negotiations and close new deals.

Work closely with your colleagues within the Customer Success and Product teams to ensure successful onboarding and long-term value for the customer.

Provide market feedback and insights that shape product and commercial development.

Who we are looking for We are looking for someone who is proactive, ambitious, and results-driven – with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to move deals forward. You will thrive in this role if you have experience with B2B sales, preferably within SaaS. We also believe that you have:

A strong set of communication skills and the ability to build trust quickly.

A comprehensive and solution‑oriented mindset.

Natural authority and execution power, combined with a positive and pragmatic attitude.

Hunter mentality.

"Grit" – you don't give up, even when the work presents challenges.

The ability to communicate fluently in both Swedish and English.

A valid driver’s license.

Experience from the transportation or logistics industry is considered a plus, as well as the ability to “speak tech,” such as understanding APIs, integrations, and technical concepts.
Interested? Contact us! Does this sound like a role and environment that would suit you? Apply, connect with us, or share this opportunity with someone you think might be a great fit.
If you have questions, reach out to Linnea Olsson, People Business Partner at Movement Software.
We are a part of Movement Software
Ecoroute is part of Movement Software (formerly Progrits), a Northern European software group consisting of around twenty entrepreneur-led companies across three business areas: Vehicle digital solutions, Transport & logistics, and the public mobility. Since 2023, Movement Software has been part of Axcel, a Nordic private equity firm with a strong focus on the technology sector.
Being part of Movement Software provides us with greater opportunities for growth and development, both as a company and as individuals, while also offering the stability and resources of a larger group.

jobs.occupation: Sales Representative  Flygprestanda AB
jobs.description:
Take your sales career to new heights in aviation technology!
About Flygprestanda
Since 1969, Flygprestanda AB has been at the forefront of aviation performance technology. With decades of industry expertise, we develop innovative Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions that help airlines and aircraft operators worldwide perform safe and efficient takeoff and landing performance calculations.
Based in central Malmö, we combine deep aviation knowledge with cutting-edge technology to deliver solutions that make a real difference in aviation safety.
Now, we're looking for a motivated and commercially minded Sales Representative to join our close-knit Sales & Marketing team and help us reach new heights.

The opportunity
Are you a natural communicator who enjoys building relationships, discovering new business opportunities, and turning conversations into successful partnerships? Are you curious about technology and excited by the prospect of working with customers around the world?
As our Sales Representative, you'll play a key role in driving growth and expanding our international customer base. You'll connect with prospective and existing customers, present innovative software solutions, and help airlines and aircraft operators discover how our technology can support their operations.
This is a varied, hands-on role where you'll combine proactive sales, customer engagement, online product demonstrations, and account management. You'll also work closely with colleagues across engineering, software development, finance, and marketing, gaining valuable insight into both our products and the aviation industry.
What you'll be doing
Create new business opportunities by following up on inbound leads and reaching out to prospective and existing customers through calls and emails.
Build lasting customer relationships by understanding customer needs, identifying opportunities, and providing a professional, responsive experience.
Drive sales forward by preparing commercial proposals, negotiating offers, and closing deals to achieve sales targets.
Showcase our technology by delivering engaging online demonstrations that bring the benefits of our software to life.
Support our customers and sales pipeline through account administration and accurate maintenance of customer and prospect databases.
Discover new opportunities through market research, industry insights, and competitor analysis.
Collaborate across teams to ensure a smooth customer journey, from the first conversation to a successful partnership.

Who we're looking for
We're looking for someone who is proactive, organized, and motivated by results. You enjoy taking initiative, communicating with people, and finding solutions that create value for customers.
You don't shy away from picking up the phone, following up on opportunities, or starting conversations with new prospects. You're equally comfortable working independently and contributing to a collaborative team environment.
You may already have experience in sales, or you may be ready to take the next step in your commercial career. An interest in technology, digital solutions, or aviation would be a great advantage.
You'll bring:
Previous sales experience and a genuine interest in developing new business.
Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate with international customers.
Strong listening and interpersonal skills, with a customer-first mindset.
Experience using CRM systems and MS Office or LibreOffice.
The ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and organize your working day.
A structured, thorough, and solution-oriented approach to your work.
A positive team spirit and a professional attitude.

Experience in the aviation industry and a degree in business or a related field are advantageous, but not essential. Some international travel may be required.
Why join Flygprestanda?
International reach: Work with airlines and aircraft operators across the world.
Meaningful technology: Represent software solutions that contribute to safe aviation operations.
A varied role: Combine sales, customer relationships, technology, and market development.
A collaborative environment: Work closely with knowledgeable colleagues across multiple disciplines.
A strong industry foundation: Join a company with a long history of aviation expertise and a forward-looking approach to technology.

Practical information
Location: Central Malmö, Sweden
Salary: Starting from SEK 34,000 per month
Travel: Some international travel may be required
Ready for takeoff?
If you're driven by sales, enjoy building international relationships, and want to work at the intersection of technology and aviation, we'd love to hear from you.
Send your CV and personal letter to **careers@flygp.se** not later than 28/11-2026.
Questions about the role? Contact Åke Grundemar at 040-642 00 26 or 0765-262 626, or email quality@flygp.se.
Note: This position may be appointed prior to above stated deadline.

jobs.occupation: Head of Product Development
jobs.description:
Want to take over the technical leadership of a Nordic market leader? Skip the corporate bureaucracy, drive next-generation structural engineering, and build the new product portfolio for the infrastructure that will support the global transition to 6G. Today Cue Dee are a leading supplier to leading mobile operators, TowerCo (Tower Company) and system integrators in Europe.

This recruitment is conducted in collaboration with Jefferson Wells. However, you will be employed directly by CUE DEE AB.

Cue Dee is the Nordic market leader in telecom infrastructure solutions, with a strong market presence and office in Stockholm, Umeå and Gdansk. Backed by the stable Lagercrantz Group, we combine 45+ years of heritage with global industrial manufacturing-and we are gearing up to celebrate our 50th anniversary in 2028. We develop and sell specific steel and aluminum structures used at telecom sites and rooftops worldwide.

We design, develop, and supply optimized steel and aluminum structures, both standard and customized, for telecom sites and rooftop applications worldwide.

 We are looking for our new Head of Product Development. This is a structured succession role: you will start hands-on alongside our current R&D Manager. Within 6-12 months, you will fully take over the function, join the Management Team, report directly to the CEO, and take on formal responsibility for your own team of senior and junior designers.

The Mission: Technical Leadership, develop new products for the infrastructure for 6G Innovation
 This role is heavily weighted toward structural technology and design, giving you the mandate to shape our technical roadmap as the world prepares for the implementation of 6G.

 
Design for Manufacture: Drive mechanical and structural product development from raw requirements to market-ready products. You ensure that what you and the team design can be manufactured efficiently.
Commercial Acumen: You apply your technical expertise to lay the strategic and technical groundwork for new deals, providing our sales team with the perfect product foundation to close agreements. You need to be business driven and open to meeting and understanding customers to industrialize the customer needs into our new product portfolio.
Presence & Travel: Your base is in Kista, but you will visit our other office outside Umeå and our team in Poland. Travel is primarily within Sweden and Europe (approx. 15-20 days per year) to meet customers, production teams, and suppliers.

 

 Who You Are
 You are a sharp mechanical engineer with leadership experience who wants to make a real business impact. Telecom industry experience is welcomed but not required for this role. We place great value on strong engineering expertise in areas such as structural design, mechanics, and materials engineering. At the same time, we believe that experience from other industries can bring fresh perspectives, innovative ideas, and valuable expertise that strengthen our team and drive continuous improvement.
Leadership Experience: Proven experience leading and coaching a smaller group of engineers or product developers.
The Foundation: A relevant technical degree or engineering background, combined with a solid track record in mechanical product development and manufacturing.
The Tech & Material Edge: Knowledge in structural design and in materials, manufacturing methods, materials and particularly steel and aluminum.
Building/Structural Mindset: Since our products are installed in demanding environments (often on existing building rooftops), a solid understanding of structural engineering, load-bearing structures, or building technology is an advantage.
The Mindset: Accountable, pragmatic, and business-minded. You avoid unnecessary overengineering and focus on safety, compliance, cost-efficiency, and manufacturability.
Language: Fluent English. Swedish is a strong asset.

Why Cue Dee?
 You get the financial backing of a powerhouse group, but the speed, impact, and entrepreneurial culture of an agile, market-leading 30-person company.

Short decision-making paths, real product ownership, and direct interaction with the CEO enable you to take ideas from concept to finished product with speed and impact.

Ready to level up your career? 
 Apply today at www.jeffersonwells.se.
 For more information please contact Headhunter Thomas Andersson at Jefferson Wells 070-276 9953.
